StageAttention: ['TBD', 'Rusalka leaps into the air and unleashes a series of spinning strikes. She then charges her shoulder cannon, fires a beam, and drops back down.', "Rusalka's weapon splits into multiple flying blades that hover around her. She sweeps her right hand, sending the blades slashing sideways, then follows with a backflip kick. She arcs through the air, using her whole body to drive the blades into a spinning slash.", 'Rusalka leaps into the air with the flying blades circling her leg, then kicks downward. After she lands, the blades spin faster and faster around her before fully extending and triggering a large explosion.', 'Rusalka strikes forward with her flying blades. On hit, the spinning blades lift the target into the air and tear into it before slamming it back down.', 'Rusalka scatters her flying blades through the air and links them with lightning. She swings the linked blades twice, then brings them crashing down to finish the attack.', 'Rusalka zigzags into the air, leaving three shadow clones along her path. The clones dive in one after another to attack 3 times, then merge back into her before she finishes with a plunging strike.', 'Rusalka rises high into the air, looks down on the character, and unleashes a sustained barrage of lightning-charged flying blades.']
